h: Empress Njamah shares plans Francis Duru's wife had for him before his death
p: Actress Empress Njamah has reportedly revealed what the late Francis Duru's wife had planned for him before his sudden death. An old prophecy about his passing has also resurfaced, drawing reactions from Nollywood colleagues.
more: A family source has shared details about his final hours.
Tributes continue to pour in from across Nollywood.
